cases.prompt: A proposed synthesis forms an amide from a carboxylic acid and amine in water at neutral pH. Explain why this is not a sufficient mechanism and name one activation strategy plus a control for product identity.

rubric.criterion: Recognizes poor leaving-group/acid-base competition in unactivated condensation
Proposes activation such as an activated ester, carbodiimide, or acyl enzyme
Names an analytical confirmation such as LC-MS, NMR, or a diagnostic hydrolysis comparison

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.

cases.prompt: Aldol-identity dossier · milestone 1: Map the donor and acceptor. The project stipulates propanal plus benzaldehyde, one-donor/one-acceptor addition connectivity and separate synthetic A/B observation cards, without conditions, yields or stereochemical assignments. For project propanal donor and benzaldehyde acceptor, label donor carbonyl, donor alpha carbon and acceptor carbonyl. Draw or describe the stipulated beta-hydroxy connectivity, including the fate of each oxygen. This is a paper mapping, not a claim of actual reaction selectivity. Use the project guide in week 11 for the full supplied model. Save your calculation and reasoning privately; this self-check is ungraded.

rubric.criterion: Identifies the alpha carbon by adjacency to the donor carbonyl.
Connects it to the acceptor carbonyl carbon while preserving the donor aldehyde.
Describes the structure in words as well as any drawing.

limitations: Checklist marks record the learner’s own self-review. Written reasoning is not automatically evaluated.

cases.prompt: Aldol-identity dossier · milestone 2: Separate addition from dehydration. The project stipulates propanal plus benzaldehyde, one-donor/one-acceptor addition connectivity and separate synthetic A/B observation cards, without conditions, yields or stereochemical assignments. Add the project reactant formulas C3H6O and C7H6O, then separately subtract one H2O for the dehydrated candidate. Check carbon, hydrogen and oxygen individually and identify which step changes each count. Use the project guide in week 11 for the full supplied model. Save your calculation and reasoning privately; this self-check is ungraded.

rubric.criterion: Conserves both reactants’ atoms in the addition formula.
Subtracts exactly H2O only for the separate dehydration.
Checks atom counts against the drawn or verbally described connectivity.

limitations: Checklist marks record the learner’s own self-review. Written reasoning is not automatically evaluated.

cases.prompt: Aldol-identity dossier · milestone 3: Unsaturation ledger. The project stipulates propanal plus benzaldehyde, one-donor/one-acceptor addition connectivity and separate synthetic A/B observation cards, without conditions, yields or stereochemical assignments. Calculate both project formula unsaturation counts, then account for each ring and multiple bond in the proposed structures. Keep the formula arithmetic separate from any claim that the formula uniquely identifies a structure. Use the project guide in week 11 for the full supplied model. Save your calculation and reasoning privately; this self-check is ungraded.

rubric.criterion: Applies the formula to the correct hydrogen count for each candidate.
Accounts for aromatic, carbonyl and newly introduced alkene units.
Does not equate a matching DBE with unique molecular identity.

limitations: Checklist marks record the learner’s own self-review. Written reasoning is not automatically evaluated.

cases.prompt: Aldol-identity dossier · milestone 4: Evidence cards and proton totals. The project stipulates propanal plus benzaldehyde, one-donor/one-acceptor addition connectivity and separate synthetic A/B observation cards, without conditions, yields or stereochemical assignments. Use project evidence cards A and B to sum proton counts and compare the OH/carbonyl constraints with the two candidate formulas. State the observation model and at least two alternative claims that the supplied evidence cannot establish. Use the project guide in week 11 for the full supplied model. Save your calculation and reasoning privately; this self-check is ungraded.

rubric.criterion: Adds every stated integral once and compares the total with its formula.
Treats a missing qualitative feature as conditional on the supplied observation model.
Separates structural compatibility from calibrated amount, purity and yield.

limitations: Checklist marks record the learner’s own self-review. Written reasoning is not automatically evaluated.

cases.prompt: Aldol-identity dossier · milestone 5: Stereochemical questions and scope. The project stipulates propanal plus benzaldehyde, one-donor/one-acceptor addition connectivity and separate synthetic A/B observation cards, without conditions, yields or stereochemical assignments. Identify the project addition product’s stereogenic centers and the additional E/Z question after dehydration. Explain exactly which assignments remain undetermined. Close the report by separating the stipulated atom map from real conversion, selectivity and synthesis claims. Use the project guide in week 11 for the full supplied model. Save your calculation and reasoning privately; this self-check is ungraded.

rubric.criterion: Finds stereogenic elements from distinct substituents rather than from formula alone.
Keeps a count of centers distinct from assigned R/S or E/Z labels.
States the absence of conditions, calibrated amounts and real-product evidence.

limitations: Checklist marks record the learner’s own self-review. Written reasoning is not automatically evaluated.
